note: Authored inputs the track fetcher cannot take from a capture record: the intended OSM relations of a trail that has no capture record, a destination point where the capture record names none, and a trail whose stored relation is the wrong route. Read by web/scripts/tracks-osm.mjs only. Every entry carries its source; the points are agent checked and need a person's check.

nuvolau.source: docs/v2/research/lanes/CS7b-dolomites-tracks.md, 3.28: paths 443, 439, 464 and 452 from cortina.dolomiti.org 'To Rifugio Nuvolau' (9.8 km, 612 m, from and back to Passo Giau); Rifugio Nuvolau has no capture record

lagazuoi.wrong_route: the stored relation is the Kaiserjäger Steig (the way up), not the tunnels; no OSM relation exists for the Galleria del Lagazuoi

siusi.wrong_route: the stored relation is path 12 from Seis, which does not reach Compatsch; which plateau walk is meant is an owner question

tre-cime.source: suedtirol.info 'Summer walk around the Drei Zinnen': a loop, trail no. 101 then no. 105 back to the start (docs/v2/research/lanes/CS7b-dolomites-tracks.md, 3.28)

federa.source: Wikidata Q3825692 P625 (Lago Federa), the point of capture ref place/lago-federa in data/relevance/inputs/points.json
